title: Radio Vaigyaaniq Future File Structure

notes: This manifest is a future organization plan.
It does not move current public HTML files.
Existing browser-openable URLs remain the compatibility source until shims are implemented.

currentRoots.purpose: Static browser archive and entry index

futureRoots.purpose: Complete app shells and standalone frames
Individual user-facing pages grouped by runtime area
Reusable audio, TTS, Three.js, lyrics, social, and intake engines
Operator task flows and event sequences
Normalized station, track, lyric, storyboard, evidence, and schema data
Raw incoming HTML, JSON, CSV, Markdown, and HKD documents
Generated HKD, LRC, JSON, and WebM draft artifacts
Wireframes, storyboards, QA, release, and evidence notes

migrationPhases: Keep current files and add structure manifest.
Split repeated UI into surface modules.
Move Three.js runtime assets into runtimes/threejs.
Add import/export lanes and schema validation.
Create compatibility shims for moved public HTML files.
Add browser QA snapshots and evidence reports.
Promote only verified surfaces and keep draft surfaces labeled.
compatibilityRules: Preserve every existing /radio-html/surfaces/*.html path until a shim is committed.
Do not mark payment, audio, telemetry, or lyric timing as verified without evidence.
